definitions.gloss: manufacturing cost; cost of production; cost of goods manufactured
definitions.explanation: The total cost incurred in producing goods, including raw materials, labor, and factory overhead. A key accounting term used in financial statements and business management.

examples.japanese: {製造原価|せいぞうげんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げる→下げる：00807_sageru⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}えている→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: We are thinking of ways to reduce manufacturing costs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{原材料|げんざいりょう}→原材料：18966_genzairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高騰|こうとう}→高騰：14647_koutou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{製造原価|せいぞうげんか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: Manufacturing costs rose due to the surge in raw material prices.

examples.english: Manufacturing cost includes three elements: material costs, labor costs, and overhead expenses.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{製造|せいぞう}→製造：03289_seizou⟧ (manufacturing) and ⟦{原価|げんか}→原価：05470_genka⟧ (cost price, prime cost). This is a fundamental accounting and business term used in {製造原価報告書|せいぞうげんかほうこくしょ} (manufacturing cost statements), which are part of standard Japanese financial reporting for manufacturing companies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {製造原価|せいぞうげんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}する→計算する：25526_keisansuru⟧: to calculate manufacturing cost
- {製造原価|せいぞうげんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{削減|さくげん}する→削減する：25399_sakugensuru⟧: to cut manufacturing costs
- {製造原価|せいぞうげんか}⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧: manufacturing cost statement
- ⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦{一個|いっこ}→一個：08922_ikko⟧⟦{当|あ}たり→当たり：01919_atari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{製造原価|せいぞうげんか}: manufacturing cost per unit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{原価|げんか}→原価：05470_genka⟧: cost price — broader term covering manufacturing, purchasing, or service delivery costs
- {売上原価|うりあげげんか}: cost of goods sold — the cost recognized when goods are actually sold
- {仕入原価|しいれげんか}: purchase cost — cost of goods bought from suppliers for resale
